lines.zh: 爬行缓慢，南瓜藏身其中。
lines.en: Creeps slowly, hiding in the pumpkin.
Camouflages as a pumpkin to avoid enemies.
Camouflages as a pumpkin, hard to spot.
Camouflaged as a pumpkin, waiting for opportunity.

lines.zh: 八条腿顶着南瓜壳挪动。
lines.en: Eight legs shift the pumpkin shell along.

lines.zh: 南瓜在地上滚了一小段。
lines.en: The pumpkin rolls a short way.

lines.zh: 腿从南瓜底下伸出来走。
lines.en: Legs reach out from under the pumpkin.
The shell is heavy, so I crawl slowly.
I creep along the grass to the bushes.

lines.zh: 一步步靠近下一片南瓜地。
lines.en: Step by step toward the next pumpkin patch.

lines.zh: 静静躺卧，南瓜为我作掩。

lines.en: Sleeps in the pumpkin, waiting for prey.
Safe and waiting in the pumpkin.

lines.zh: 一动不动，和南瓜没两样。
lines.en: Not moving; I look exactly like a pumpkin.
The vine on my shell stirs in the wind.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家，立即现身攻击。
玩家接近，南瓜显现攻击。
lines.en: Player near, pumpkin appears to attack.

lines.zh: 玩家出现，南瓜转为攻击。
lines.en: Player arrives, pumpkin turns to attack.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，南瓜现身攻击。
lines.en: Detects player, pumpkin appears to attack.

lines.zh: 玩家靠近，南瓜现身攻击。
lines.en: Player near, pumpkin appears to attack.

lines.zh: 玩家出现，南瓜现身攻击。
lines.en: Player arrives, pumpkin appears to attack.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家，南瓜现身攻击。
lines.en: Detects player, pumpkin appears to attack.
Between the shell seams, eight eyes shine.
You came close, so the shell lifts.
The shell cracked and two legs broke.
The pumpkin split and juice runs out.

lines.zh: 你真以为我会轻易放过你？
lines.en: You really think I’ll just let you go?

lines.zh: 你别想靠近，南瓜壳不是用来吃的！
lines.en: Don’t think I won’t notice you getting closer, pumpkin isn’t food!

lines.zh: 伪装只是暂时的，看看我的触手吧！
lines.en: My tentacles will show you the deception.
Feel the taste of the pumpkin!
My fangs hide inside this pumpkin.

lines.zh: 伪装不住了，我要攻击了！
lines.en: The disguise is over, I’m attacking!

lines.zh: 南瓜壳在哪儿，我就在哪儿！
lines.en: Where the pumpkin is, that’s where I am!

lines.zh: 别试图逃跑，我已经看见你了！
lines.en: You can’t run, I’m already seeing you!

lines.zh: 我的触手能让你变成南瓜！
lines.en: My tentacles can turn you into a pumpkin!

lines.zh: 你太接近了，我需要警告你！
lines.en: You’re too close, I need to warn you!
Don’t touch me, I’m a pumpkin!
Be careful, my tentacles might wrap around you!

lines.zh: 南瓜壳一歪，我的八条腿全露出来。
lines.en: The pumpkin shell tips, and all eight legs show.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，现在轮到你了！
lines.en: You’ve bumped into me, now it’s your turn!

lines.zh: 碰我干什么？我只是个南瓜！
lines.en: What are you touching me for? I’m just a pumpkin!

lines.zh: 小心触手，它们不是玩具！
lines.en: Be careful with the tentacles, they’re not toys!
Don’t touch me, I won’t move!
Find the pumpkin, and you’ll find me!
I am the true king of pumpkins!
We are of the same kind, want to try it?
A kiss, and the pumpkin will be sweeter!

lines.zh: 我们的爱就像南瓜一样永恒！
lines.en: Our love is as eternal as the pumpkin!

lines.zh: 来吧，让我们成为真正的南瓜！
lines.en: Come on, let’s become true pumpkins!

lines.zh: 一起化作南瓜，共享甜蜜！
lines.en: Together, become pumpkins and share the sweetness!

lines.zh: 只有南瓜才能理解南瓜的心！
lines.en: Only a pumpkin can understand another pumpkin’s heart!

lines.zh: 亲吻我，让南瓜更加美味！
lines.en: Kiss me, make the pumpkin even more delicious!
The shell flips and I spring out.
Hind legs loaded, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，不交出食物就别怪我了！
lines.en: Hiss, give me the food or suffer!

lines.zh: 你敢碰我？南瓜蜘蛛绝不是吃素的！
lines.en: Touch me? Pumpkin Spiders aren't for snacks!

lines.zh: 别想跑！南瓜蜘蛛的速度可不慢！
lines.en: You can't run! Pumpkin Spiders are fast!

lines.zh: 嘶，你离我近点，我会给你惊喜！
lines.en: Hiss, come closer, I have a surprise for you!

lines.zh: 别看南瓜，我的獠牙才可怕！
lines.en: Don't look at the pumpkin, my fangs are scary!

lines.zh: 南瓜外壳只是一层伪装！
lines.en: The pumpkin shell is just a disguise!
Give me a pumpkin, change things up!
Can you trade blood bottles for pumpkins?

lines.zh: 大地是我的家，别想轻易夺走！
lines.en: The earth is my home, don't try to take it!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，我是南瓜，也是危险！
lines.en: Hiss, I'm a pumpkin, and a threat!

lines.zh: 南瓜下有惊喜，也有危险！
伪装与攻击，我的生存之道！
南瓜下，等待最勇敢的猎物！
lines.en: Under the pumpkins, waiting for the bravest!
My disguise makes me hard to find!
Beneath the earth, I'm the king!

lines.zh: 南瓜壳下，隐藏着我的爪牙！
lines.en: Inside the pumpkin shell, my claws hide!

lines.zh: 南瓜壳烤焦了，我跳出来。
lines.en: The pumpkin shell charred, so I leap out.
